confirmed_contrasts.nmda: n12 produced a robust tuft event in 8/8 train and 8/8 validation trajectories; n8 remained near the registered boundary
confirmed_contrasts.calcium: paired n12 produced a robust hot-zone event in 8/8 train and 8/8 validation trajectories, while unpaired n12 stayed negative and paired n8 stayed mostly negative

protocol_transcription_failures.somatic: S1c used one 3 nA pulse as the positive, but the immutable one-pulse calibration selected 6 nA; the observed -61.2 mV peak is exactly consistent with the historical 3 nA negative trial
protocol_transcription_failures.bap: S1c used an n8/b2/w800 assist and two 3 nA pulses; the validated contract instead selected n12/b3/w400 as the assist and bracketed BAP with currents derived from the calibrated two-pulse 3 nA base

scientific_findings.background_interpretation: Eighty-millisecond stochastic windows contained no active peak. This is insufficient to reject rare-event background protocols that were evaluated over 6000 ms in S1b; they remain controls rather than targeted event arms.

repair_scope: exact 3 nA versus 6 nA one-pulse somatic boundary
